summary: BifrOSt has a 58-type table with identifiers, conformance tree, extensions, MIME mapping and descriptions, exposed to apps through the SDK. Apps cannot declare their own exported or imported types, the tag-class API is limited to extension and MIME, and the Apple system type catalogue is much smaller than the official list.

features.note: conforms and distance cover the parent tree; the table has 58 types
case-insensitive; used by Files and the pasteboard

features.feature: Type from MIME type and back
features.note: wildcards such as image/* name the abstract type
English strings only, no localization tables

features.apple: UTTagClass and tags(), UTType.tags for other classes
features.note: no API for tag classes other than filenameExtension and mimeType

features.apple: UTExportedTypeDeclarations, UTImportedTypeDeclarations, Defining file and data types for your app
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/share.rs (manifest handles only receive known UTIs)
features.note: apps cannot register a proprietary UTI with an extension, MIME type and conformance; the manifest only lists types an app opens

features.apple: System-declared uniform type identifiers (the Apple list on the landing page)
features.note: covers the common images, audio, video, text, archive, code and document types; no 3D, Apple-only, Shazam or bundle types
text, URL and file payloads only

features.feature: Open and share targets by type
features.apple: Document types and handled types in Info.plist
features.note: receiving works from the manifest list; no per-app rank or default-handler API from the type

features.feature: Document read and write by type
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/document.rs:40 (Document trait: read, write, readable_types, default_type)
features.note: type strings are UTIs; no writable types list or conversion rules

features.feature: Conformance check for tag matching in file kind
features.note: only PNG and JPEG count as Image in the viewer, as recorded in docs/bifrost-ui.md:335

gaps: App-declared exported and imported types with extension, MIME and conformance (UTExportedTypeDeclarations equivalent)
Generic UTTagClass API beyond filenameExtension and mimeType
Most of the system-declared identifiers on the landing page, including 3D, Apple-only, Shazam and bundle types
Writable types and type conversion for documents
